about_the_game:
Shi's Summer Battle is a casual leveling game that combines pop-ups, tower climbing, and Roguelike. The game is based on Roguelike elements, hoping to reduce the player's operation at the same time, can let the player more free and precise to form their own build.

In the game, players will choose props and configure their own team, as the player to break through the main force, configure the building, set up a team, the game has a variety of props, gain props, benefit props, combinations of various teams, to enhance the team's combat power, to challenge the increasingly strong enemy.

Each prop has its own unique function, which makes each prop has a completely different game idea, enhance the output or enhance the combat power, etc., to get more powerful buffs, so that your character to get more points, to defeat more enemies.

Props:

Props can produce resources, weapons, props, is an important source of team action, resources, get buffs, configure a reasonable team, is the key content of the game.

Combat:

Each prop has its unique production progress bar, a team can configure 5 props, when the progress value is full, will get the function output of these 5 props, such as bullets-medicine and so on, faster progress-more powerful bullets, and so on.

Teams:

A team can be configured with 5 props, players can directly use gold to increase the team, the enemy's team will also become more later, the team increased, will need to configure a more reasonable team in order to defeat the enemy
